articles.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia Attack on Oil Refinery in Jazan
articles.description: The Arab Parliament condemned in the strongest terms the attack by the terrorist Houthi militia on the oil refinery in Jazan Region, which resulted in the death of one worker and injuries to several others of various nationalities. The parliament stressed that the attack constitutes a new hostile escalation and a flagrant violation of international law, reflecting the Houthi militia's continued terrorist approach of targeting vital and civilian facilities, SPA reported.
